title: [AINews] Meta Muse Wonder & Wonder Full: MSL’s Claude 5.5-tier Frontier Model
description: MSL’s emergence as a frontier lab is finally complete.
summary: We have been coveringe MSL’s 14 month journey to becoming a frontier lab , but only today did the final ball drop: Meta’s Muse Wonder to match Spark and Glimmer , the way that OpenAI has Sol/Terra/Luna and Anthropic has Opus/Sonnet/Haiku. takeaways: Meta pitches the models as SOTA for “personal and professional agentic work.” @alexandr_wang named three headline features: Active Memory: memory across days, weeks and months.

Specs: 1M context Input: text, image, video and audio; output: text only Pricing: $4 input / $0.20 cached input / $20 output per M tokens Vals AI ( @ValsAI ): Wonder Full (Max): #5 on the Vals Index, +6.4 points over its predecessor and ahead of every OpenAI model.

Interestingly, while Muse doesn’t claim a specific size, Muse Wonder Full does beat Fable and Astra on some benchmarks, and with various degrees of posttraining it is a little unclear if Wonder is more of a Fable/Astra class model or not.
